posts.text: As I am not following this stock closely, am not in a position to help as regards time frame for sales realisation. There is very little details available as the company never makes any con call. And management is ultra conservative. In my opinion it is not right company to invest presently, when there is general pessimism in stock prices and manygood companies with bright prospects offer entry points.
